description.value: Little George's Express Pizza & Pasta is a local pizzeria and pasta restaurant in central/south Nanaimo serving a broad menu of classic Italian pies alongside Indo-Canadian fusion options like butter chicken and tandoori paneer pizzas. The restaurant covers wings, burgers, pasta bakes, calamari, and a range of appetizers, making it a solid stop for a hearty post-ride meal. Both pickup and local delivery are available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM phone number (250-754-3271) and URL. The website footer provides a street address (398 Bruce Avenue, Nanaimo, BC) that OSM lacks (OSM only records addr:unit=3 with no street). Takeout is explicitly confirmed by 'Pick Up or Delivery Come to us, or we come to you' on the homepage. Vegetarian items (Butter Paneer, Tandoori Paneer Delight, Fried Zucchini Sticks, Tossed Salad) are clearly listed on the menu. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM records only addr:unit=3 with no street address; website footer shows '398 Bruce Avenue, Nanaimo, BC' — street address added from website, unit number not confirmed on website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Nanaimo with a confirmed website and phone number. A clear fueling option for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes vegetarian pizzas (Butter Paneer, Tandoori Paneer Delight), Fried Zucchini Sticks, Tossed Salad, Garlic Bread, and Pita with Hummus or Tzatziki. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
